== Biography ==
Margaret was born about 1644. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1159|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[Weir-3979|Catherine Weir]].

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margrat Glasgow and John Aiton on 18 October 1693 at Cambusnethan.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 628/10 / 344; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Margaret Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Margaret Glasgow and John Tailzer on 18 December 1690 at Walston.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 658/10 / 206; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
